rows.label: qst200207_msg0002
rows.name:
What's this all of a sudden?
Who are you, anyway?

rows.label: qst200207_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm not anyone suspicious.
I just want to ask a few questions.

rows.label: qst200207_msg0004
rows.name:
Anyone who says they're not suspicious
is the most suspicious of all.

rows.label: qst200207_msg0005
rows.name:
If you're a debt collector, get lost.
I don't have any money to repay!

rows.label: qst200207_msg0006
rows.name:
Or do you intend to kill me and
take the house and everything!?

rows.label: qst200207_msg0007
rows.name:
I won't do such a thing. I just
want you to tell me about Harhal.

rows.label: qst200207_msg0008
rows.name:
Hah! I don't know anything about
that wayward daughter!

rows.label: qst200207_msg0010
rows.name:
She doesn't care how her mother feels.
She's such a selfish girl!

rows.label: qst200207_msg0011
rows.name:
Aren't you worried
about your daughter?

rows.label: qst200207_msg0013
rows.name:
What could a total stranger like you
possibly know about us?!
